properties.name: weakcrypto:config
properties.value: skill pq-crypto, 2 scouts, max iterations 400, build 42f2b04a3e42

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-CBC mode used for symmetric encryption in multiple files. CBC mode without an authenticated-encryption construction is malleable unless a MAC is applied separately.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Static IV/nonce from literals is used for symmetric encryption. This reuse under one key breaks CTR/GCM catastrophically.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES at 128-bit is used for symmetric encryption. While quantum-resistant, it's below CNSA 2.0 requirements with only a 64-bit quantum margin.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES in GCM mode (authenticated encryption) is used. Key size is not explicitly stated and is graded at the AES-128 floor with only a 64-bit quantum margin.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES at 256-bit is used for symmetric encryption. This provides a 128-bit quantum margin, meeting CNSA 2.0 requirements.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Cryptographically secure randomness is used through OpenSSL::Random.random_bytes and SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64. These are appropriate for cryptographic nonce generation.
